meta.title: Yamoo — local honey, simply
meta.description: Yamoo is a private, locally hosted honey client with no trackers or third-party CDNs.
brand.name: Yamoo
home.eyebrow: Sri Lankan honey, without the noise
home.title: A calm place to find honest honey.
home.lede: Yamoo is a lightweight client for browsing, saving, and signing in — no trackers, no third-party scripts.
home.feature.local.title: Local-first
home.feature.local.body: Preferences stay on this device. Nothing is sent unless you ask.
home.feature.access.title: Built to be used
home.feature.access.body: High contrast, 44px controls, and screen-reader labels throughout.
home.feature.private.title: Private by default
home.feature.private.body: HTTPS only. No analytics. No CDNs. Fonts and icons ship with the app.
account.title: Account
account.lede: Sign in stays on this device until a backend is connected.
account.error: Enter a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
account.settings.lede: Your profile, language, support, and account controls.
account.profile.lede: This name is shown on bookings and reviews.
account.name: Full name
account.name.invalid: Enter a name of at least two characters.
account.phone.lede: Sri Lanka mobile numbers. A one-time code confirms any change.
account.phone.sent: A code was sent to that number.
account.phone.invalid: Enter a Sri Lankan mobile number.
account.email.lede: A one-time code must reach the new address before it replaces the current one.
account.email.sent: A code was sent to that email.
account.otp.invalid: Enter the 6-digit code from the message.
account.language.lede: Yamoo updates on this device as soon as you choose a language.
account.support.lede: Tell us what you need. Tickets stay on this device until a backend is connected.
account.support.subject: Subject
account.support.invalid: Add a subject and a short message.
account.delete.lede: This permanently removes your Yamoo profile, bookings, and saved salons from this account.
account.delete.step1.title: Delete your account?
account.delete.step1.body: This cannot be undone. Your profile, bookings, notices, and saved salons will be removed.
account.delete.step2.title: Confirm permanent deletion
account.delete.step2.body: Type DELETE to confirm you want this account closed forever.
errors.code.phone-required: Please enter a Sri Lankan mobile number.
errors.code.email-required: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.code.otp-required: Please request a one-time code first.
errors.code.otp-invalid: That code did not match. Request a new one if it expired.
errors.code.otp-expired: That code expired. Send a new one.
errors.code.support-required: Please add a subject and a short message.
errors.code.deletion-confirm: Type DELETE to permanently close this account.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: This client does not include analytics, ads, or third-party beacons.
privacy.body: We serve only first-party HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, and icons. The static server upgrades insecure requests, refuses mixed content, and never loads remote scripts.
footer.copy: Yamoo. Honey, cream, and forest green — locally hosted.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: That path is not part of this client.
offline.banner: You're offline. Yamoo will reconnect when the network is back.
errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.offline: You appear to be offline. Reconnect and try again.
errors.https: This app only talks to HTTPS services.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
errors.http.400: Some details look incomplete. Please review and try again.
errors.http.403: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.http.404: We could not find what you asked for.
errors.http.409: That clashes with existing data. Please try again.
errors.http.422: Those details could not be accepted.
errors.http.429: Too many tries. Pause for a moment, then retry.
errors.http.500: The service hit a temporary problem.
errors.http.503: The service is unavailable right now.
gate.title: Please agree before continuing
gate.lede: Yamoo needs your agreement to the community rules and the current privacy policy.
gate.community.title: Community rules
gate.community.body: Be kind, honest, and fair. No scams, harassment, or fake listings. Yamoo is a calm marketplace for real honey.
gate.privacy.title: Privacy policy
gate.privacy.body: We keep sign-in on this device until a backend is connected. We do not run analytics or third-party trackers. The policy version is shown above.
gate.confirm.community: I agree to the community rules
gate.confirm.privacy: I agree to the privacy policy
gate.required: Both agreements are required to use Yamoo.
